findings.evidence: The two iron hinges are mounted across the solid top crest of the curved lid where there is no seam, rather than along the back seam where the lid meets the chest body, so the lid could not pivot open.
The two iron hinges are placed on top of the lid instead of along the back edge as requested by the spec.
The swinging hasp plate of the latch has four rivets fastening it directly into the lower wooden box in addition to sitting over a staple loop, which would prevent the latch from lifting.
